'''The Sand Bar''' was a dining and drinking establishment located in [[The Puddle]]. It was owned by [[Gantlo]]. The building was one of the few in The Puddle that was kept in good repair. It had three rooms; a bar, a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]], and a kitchen.<ref name="H&S" />
